//: Daniel Defense GL/SSC-style 12.5-inch .223 upper. Stats sit between the 14.5-inch M4A1 and the 10.3-inch Mk18 CQBR.
description: A complete 12.5-inch upper receiver assembly chambered in .223 Remington / 5.56 NATO, modeled on the Daniel Defense GL/SSC.  The carbine-length barrel splits the difference between a full M4 and a stubby CQBR, keeping things handy without giving up too much velocity.  Pairs naturally with a stand-off grenade launcher and a short can.  Feeds from standard STANAG magazines.

//: Accurized 16-inch recce build. Same length as the standard mid-length upper but tuned for a tighter group.
description: A 16-inch 'recce' upper receiver in .223 Remington / 5.56 NATO, built around a heavier match-grade barrel and free-float rail.  A favorite of reconnaissance elements who want carbine handling with rifle-grade precision.  Feeds from standard STANAG magazines.

//: Mk12 Special Purpose Rifle. 18-inch precision upper for the AR/M4 lower.
description: An 18-inch Mk 12 Special Purpose Rifle upper receiver in .223 Remington / 5.56 NATO.  The long, heavy match barrel and rifle-length gas system wring maximum accuracy and range out of the cartridge, turning an ordinary carbine lower into a designated marksman's rifle.  Feeds from standard STANAG magazines.
